name: @guardbee/mcp-server-auditor
description: MCP server that audits other MCP servers' tool definitions for insecure patterns — excessive-agency tool names, shell/eval/SQL/SSRF sinks fed by raw tool input, overly permissive schemas, hardcoded secrets, and wildcard CORS
long_description: Scans an MCP server's own source code for risky tool-definition patterns: tool names that grant shell/SQL execution, handlers that pass raw tool input straight into exec()/eval()/fetch()/SQL sinks (command injection, RCE, SSRF, SQL injection), tool schemas typed z.any()/z.unknown(), hardcoded secrets in schema defaults, and code that exposes the entire process.env or serves wildcard CORS. No API key required — runs entirely locally.
